title: Morgan Fairchild Joins OnlyFans at 76
excerpt: Hollywood veteran Morgan Fairchild, 76, announced she is joining OnlyFans, saying her page will feature new photos and videos — but not explicit content.
content:
🌎 BEYOND THE 956

Hollywood veteran Morgan Fairchild is making a surprising career move at 76: the actress announced on Thursday, November 5, 2026, that she is joining OnlyFans.

Fairchild, best known for her roles on Falcon Crest, Flamingo Road, Dallas and Search for Tomorrow, and as Chandler Bing's mother, Nora Tyler Bing, on Friends, is launching her page through Creators Inc., OnlyFans' creator management company.

She made one thing clear right away about what fans will see. “I'm putting up new pictures and videos,” she told People. “And before anyone asks, no, not that kind!”

Fairchild said her content will be personal and playful. “Mostly, it's just me being goofy and talking about whatever's on my mind,” she said. Her OnlyFans bio reads: “I'm having so much fun finding new ways to connect with people! I'm doing new pictures, new videos, and sharing my silly side! In a tech world that seems so isolating, I want to share our humanity.”

Fairchild said several friends who had already joined the platform encouraged her to try it. Fellow soap opera star Donna Mills, 85, who joined OnlyFans in July, helped convince her, explaining that the platform is looking to showcase content that is less explicit than what it is often known for.

Sources: USA Today, Entertainment Weekly, Page Six, Parade.
